criteria: A strategy must achieve positive average CLV (price taken better than closing price) over its sample.
pass_condition: Mean CLV > 0 over the evaluation window, measured against the closing line.
rationale: CLV isolates price-finding skill and removes luck from the ranking.

criteria: A strategy must have placed at least a pre-declared minimum number of bets.
pass_condition: Bet count >= minimum (methodology suggests 50+ as a starting threshold; exact value pre-declared).
rationale: Small samples are dominated by variance and cannot demonstrate skill.

criteria: Edge must hold on data the strategy has not been tuned on, using a rolling out-of-sample window.
pass_condition: CLV remains positive out-of-sample across the rolling windows.
rationale: Guards against overfitting and confirms edge is not luck from in-sample tuning.

criteria: Multi-leg strategies must only combine legs whose computed correlation is below a pre-declared bound.
pass_condition: All leg-pair correlations within the pre-declared bound.
rationale: Correlated legs distort combined edge; bounding correlation keeps combos honest.

criteria: Parlay/prop-combo legs must not share a duplicate underlying outcome.
pass_condition: No two legs resolve on the same underlying event.
rationale: Duplicate legs silently double-count risk and inflate apparent edge.

criteria: Every signal input must be traceable to an official source; no inferred or fabricated values.
pass_condition: All inputs resolve to a linked official source; unverified inputs block the signal.
rationale: Enforces the no-hallucination rule at the signal level.

criteria: Strategies must demonstrate selectivity — a bounded number of bets relative to the available slate.
pass_condition: Bets per slate <= pre-declared cap, with conviction ranking applied.
rationale: Selectively skill-based strategies take fewer, higher-conviction bets.
